persistent Grid-Ready markers earned during Production and revoked by movement, disconnection, or insufficient Power

modeledAbstractions: Network reach is recalculated from the starting grid, Generators, Link anchors, and visible Facility adjacency after Round III Realignment.
Power purchases resolve in Initiative order before each player chooses a legal subset of full Facility demands; replay receipts expose both choices.
Non-binding Power promises are modeled as explicit public decisions. They may be fulfilled, broken, superseded, or remain unexercised; no promise forces a later sale.
Headline and Tactic art/flavor never affect mechanics.
excluded: free-form future promises that are not immediate trades or binding contracts
scope.verdictBoundary: Executable 0.8.30 synchronizes physical candidate 0.5.0-rc.30-test and canonically applies the approved four-lever package: Demis Peer Validation, Elon’s realized Industrial Velocity Mandate, Jensen’s demand-coupled New Architecture, and diminishing late-Customer recognition. Every unrelated numerical rule remains frozen pending human evidence. The engine retains fresh-seed-validated deterministic profiles, full AGI-funnel and faction-value instrumentation, common-seed comparisons, configuration-specific three/four/five-player inference, causal supplier attribution, non-binding negotiation promises, provider provenance, write-only fresh decision capture, read-only replay, integrity checks, and disabled deferred modules. Registered bounds passed, but the evidence verdict remains inconclusive_precision_not_reached; synchronization and deterministic simulation are not proof of human balance, negotiation quality, physical teachability, or memorable betrayal.

persistent Grid-Ready markers earned during Production and revoked by movement, disconnection, or insufficient Power
thirteen-space sixfold-symmetric board and one simultaneous secret Jurisdictional Realignment ballot after Round III

modeledAbstractions: Network reach is recalculated from the starting grid, Generators, Link anchors, and visible Facility adjacency after Round III Realignment.
Power purchases resolve in Initiative order before each player chooses a legal subset of full Facility demands; replay receipts expose both choices.
Non-binding Power promises are modeled as explicit public decisions. They may be fulfilled, broken, superseded, or remain unexercised; no promise forces a later sale.
Headline and Tactic art/flavor never affect mechanics.
excluded: free-form future promises that are not immediate trades or binding contracts
scope.verdictBoundary: Executable 0.8.30 synchronizes physical candidate 0.5.0-rc.30-test and canonically applies the approved four-lever package: Demis Peer Validation, Elon’s realized Industrial Velocity Mandate, Jensen’s demand-coupled New Architecture, and diminishing late-Customer recognition. Every unrelated numerical rule remains frozen pending human evidence. The engine retains fresh-seed-validated deterministic profiles, full AGI-funnel and faction-value instrumentation, common-seed comparisons, configuration-specific three/four/five-player inference, causal supplier attribution, non-binding negotiation promises, provider provenance, write-only fresh decision capture, read-only replay, integrity checks, and disabled deferred modules. Registered bounds passed, but the evidence verdict remains inconclusive_precision_not_reached; synchronization and deterministic simulation are not proof of human balance, negotiation quality, physical teachability, or memorable betrayal.

scope.verdictBoundary: Executable 0.8.30 synchronizes physical candidate 0.5.0-rc.30-test and canonically applies the approved four-lever package: Demis Peer Validation, Elon’s realized Industrial Velocity Mandate, Jensen’s demand-coupled New Architecture, and diminishing late-Customer recognition. Every unrelated numerical rule remains frozen pending human evidence. The engine retains fresh-seed-validated deterministic profiles, full AGI-funnel and faction-value instrumentation, common-seed comparisons, configuration-specific three/four/five-player inference, causal supplier attribution, non-binding negotiation promises, provider provenance, write-only fresh decision capture, read-only replay, integrity checks, and disabled deferred modules. Registered bounds passed, but the evidence verdict remains inconclusive_precision_not_reached; synchronization and deterministic simulation are not proof of human balance, negotiation quality, physical teachability, or memorable betrayal.

The engine retains fresh-seed-validated deterministic profiles, full AGI-funnel and faction-value instrumentation, common-seed comparisons, configuration-specific three/four/five-player inference, causal supplier attribution, non-binding negotiation promises, provider provenance, write-only fresh decision capture, read-only replay, integrity checks, and disabled deferred modules.
